name: Simulation Core
description: Owns the system pipeline, the completion slot, and the ledger services. It does not step them.

exposesSlots.description: Ordered systems. Each one returns a proposal and does not keep step state. The first failure stops the step.
Listeners for one committed step. The caller publishes. There is no loop.
Adds one entity before any step.
Returns a copy of the ledger.
Replaces the ledger only for an open step, the next tick, the same entity ids, and positions from 0 through 1000.

author: Composable Game Platform
